en.headline: Police seek public help to find missing girl from Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: A 14-year-old left On Tai Estate on Saturday afternoon and has not been seen since; her family reported her missing on Monday, police said.
body: Police on Thursday appealed for information on a 14-year-old girl who went missing in Sau Mau Ping after leaving her home in On Tai Estate on Saturday afternoon.

The force said the family made a report on Monday, 14 September. Officers described the girl as about 1.6 metres tall and of thin build, with a sharp face, yellow complexion and long black hair. She was last seen wearing a black T-shirt, brown trousers and white sports shoes.

Anyone who has seen the girl or knows her whereabouts was asked to call the Regional Missing Persons Unit of Kowloon East on 3661 0316, or to contact any police station. The appeal was issued at 8.39am.

zh.headline: 警方尋找秀茂坪失蹤女童 家人周一報案
zh.dek: 警方周四呼籲市民提供消息，一名14歲女童上周六下午離開安泰邸住所後失蹤，家人於周一報案。
body: 警方今日呼籲市民提供一名在秀茂坪失蹤女童的消息。該名14歲女童於9月12日下午離開位於安泰邸的住所後便告失蹤。
警方表示，女童家人於9月14日向警方報案。女童身高約1.6米，瘦身材，尖面型，黃皮膚及蓄長黑髮，最後露面時身穿黑色短袖上衣、啪色長褲及白色運動鞋。
任何人如有該失蹤女童的消息或曾見過她，請致電3661 0316與東九龍總區失蹤人口調查組聯絡，或向任何一間警署提供資料。有關呼籲於早上8時39分發出。
